publicPath.description: Public URL base path for all chunk assets: the entry module, its stylesheets, the own chunks and each shared[].chunkPath resolve against it (e.g. 'http://localhost:3001/' or '/'). A relative value resolves against the host document's base URL. Shared-unit locations also resolve against it when metaData.sharedBase is absent.

sharedBase.description: Optional shared-file base location for resolving unit locations, separate from the asset base location (publicPath). When present, those locations resolve against this value by the same rules as shared[].chunkPath resolves against publicPath; when absent, they resolve against publicPath. See cpt-frontx-adr-shared-dep-reuse.

version.description: Concrete version resolved from node_modules (e.g. '19.2.4'). Contains neither ':' nor '@'. Identifies the package input only; it does not imply identical source text across MFEs.

chunkPath.description: The standalone ESM file for this dependency: an http(s) URL, or a path relative to metaData.publicPath that stays under it (e.g. 'shared/react.js'). The location rules, including the values that fail the load, are defined by cpt-frontx-adr-mfe-asset-discovery and the mfe-loading FEATURE (cpt-frontx-algo-mfe-loading-manifest-discovery, inst-md-resolve-chunk-path).

contentHash.description: Optional sha256 hex digest (64 lowercase hex characters) of this entry's file, declared by the producing build. It is the key under which the entry's text is shared across loads. See cpt-frontx-adr-mfe-asset-discovery.

units.description: The unit table: every shared chunk the manifest's lists reference, held once. See cpt-frontx-adr-shared-dep-reuse.

location.description: Location of the unit's emitted source: a path relative to the shared base location, or an absolute http(s) URL.

answers.description: The bare specifiers this unit answers, package names and subpaths alike.

imports.description: Every import edge the runtime needs for dependency-order minting: a bare specifier, or an intra-package relative edge naming the supplying unit by content identity.

lists.description: Every fetch list, held once: keyed by the exposed module name (e.g. './lifecycle', matching the exposedModule of the MFE entry that references this manifest) for a module's list, and by the target's chunk location for a lazy target's or pattern-import matching file's list. See cpt-frontx-adr-shared-dep-reuse.

contentHash.description: sha256 hex digest (64 lowercase hex characters) declared by the producing build; the key under which a unit's text is shared.

fetchList.description: One flat fetch list: the content identities of the units it needs, the own chunks it reaches statically and the keys of the lazy-target and pattern-import lists it reaches.

units.description: Content identities of the units this list delivers, each held by the manifest's unit table.

ownChunks.description: Locations of the microfrontend's own chunks the module or target reaches statically: a path relative to metaData.publicPath or an absolute http(s) URL, with no content identity.

lazy.description: Keys in lists of the lazy targets this list reaches: each the target's chunk location relative to the base that chunk resolves against.

patterns.description: Keys in lists of the pattern-import matching files this list reaches, under the same base rule as lazy.
